response.sql:
SELECT operation, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, COUNT(*) AS large_transaction_count
FROM trans
WHERE amount >= 2400
GROUP BY operation;

assumptions.assumption: Treats the cutoff as inclusive: large transactions have trans.amount >= 2400. Transactions with NULL operation form their own group; other transaction types count toward the total but are excluded from the average.

alternatives.interpretation: If “cutoff” means strictly greater than 2400, use > instead of >=.
